candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Backing changes from the baseline's red circular disc to the white rounded-square card observed in the bank's current official standalone icon; this also repairs dark-theme legibility of the black k. Emblem geometry is unchanged original vector artwork.

proposals.reason: Kutxabank's current standalone mark (official site logo and Google Play listing icon, fetched 2026-10-04) is the black lowercase rounded 'k' (#0d0d0d) with three white rivets and a red dot (#e1001b) at the stem foot, on a white rounded-square card. The accepted baseline instead puts the k on a solid red #e1001b circular disc, a treatment not evidenced in the bank's current standalone use. An original vector of the k artwork (Wikimedia Commons Kutxabank.svg, identical in structure to the mark displayed on kutxabank.es) is the replacement basis.

Working candidate selects the standalone k emblem (wordmark paths removed, emblem preserved whole) and adds a plain white rounded-square field matching the observed official app-icon presentation; only uniform scale/translation applied to the emblem.
